svg.text: A chain of five movements running straight down the page: Feynman funnels from scattered pseudoscience examples
into one diagnosis ('Cargo Cult Science'), then fans that diagnosis out into principles of integrity, and closes
by running those principles back through concrete case studies to a final wish.

g.text: Scattered examples funnel into one named diagnosis, which fans out into principles, which are tested against case

g.title: Avoiding self-deception in science — Feynman previews the talk's focus. — → spya-wv9g0v
Science tests ideas; superstition doesn't — → spya-ddrr9m
ESP, Geller, Esalen: nothing works — → spya-q4502k

Named: 'Cargo Cult Science' — form without substance — → spya-fd2muf
Report all evidence against yourself — → spya-afgs74

Millikan: slow drift toward truth — → spya-s9msxy
You are easiest to fool — → spya-bvx2u8

Young's careful rats, later ignored — → spya-fvenms
Rhine: effects shrink, repeatability denied — → spya-rbpppq

g.text: A chain: the cargo cult story names the failure, then three moves spell out what real integrity requires instead.

g.title: Islanders mimic airplane rituals — form without the substance that works — → spya-fd2muf
g.text: form without the substance that works

g.title: Missing: scientific integrity itself — → spya-afgs74

g.title: Hard subjects are no excuse — → spya-rub3a2

g.text: Three parallel examples — psychology, physics, parapsychology — each show the same failure (no real repeat test, no
real control) before converging on Feynman's closing wish.
